Here is the GMS1 filled in for your daughter as the patient. Write everything in BLOCK CAPITALS.

Patient's details
[B01] Title: NEEDS-YOU. No title is listed for your daughter. Children are often registered without one, so you can leave all four boxes empty, or tick Miss if you prefer.
[B02] Surname: RAGHUNATHAN
[B03] Date of birth: 17/09/2019
      (This is stored as printed in her passport. If it is not already in day/month/year form, rewrite it by hand as DD/MM/YYYY.)
[B04] First names: ANIKA
      (If she has a middle name, add it by hand. None is listed for her.)
[B05] NHS No.: leave blank. She has never been registered with a GP, and no NHS number is listed. The practice will find or issue one.
[B06] Previous surname/s: leave blank, unless she has ever been known by a different surname.
[B07] [ ] Male  [✔] Female
[B08] Town and country of birth: MANCHESTER, U.K.
      (The form wants both the town and the country. If the stored value has only the town, add the country after it by hand.)
[B09] Home address: 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom
      (She lives with you, so this is your home address. If the stored address ends with the postcode, cross the postcode out here, because it goes in B10.)
[B10] Postcode: 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom
      (Keep only the postcode part of the address in this box and cross out the rest.)
[B11] Telephone number: +44 7700 900123
      (Your number, as her parent and contact. Use +44 7700 900456 instead if the practice should call her mother.)

Previous medical records
[B12] Your previous address in UK: leave blank. She has never been registered with a GP.
[B13] Name of previous doctor while at that address: leave blank.
[B14] Address of previous doctor: leave blank.

If you are from abroad
[B15] Your first UK address where registered with a GP: leave blank. This registration is her first.
[B16] If previously resident in UK, date of leaving: leave blank, unless she lived in the UK before, left, and came back.
[B17] Date you first came to live in UK: NEEDS-YOU. If she was born abroad or moved to the UK, write the date she came to live here. I don't have this date. If she was born in the UK and has always lived here, leave it blank.

If you are returning from the Armed Forces
[B18] Address before enlisting: leave blank.
[B19] Service or Personnel number: leave blank.
[B20] Enlistment date: leave blank.

If you are registering a child under 5
[B21] [ ] Child Health Surveillance: NEEDS-YOU. Tick this box only if she is under 5. I can't see her date of birth, so please check her age yourself.

Dispensing
[B22] Leave both boxes empty, unless you live more than a mile from the nearest chemist or would have serious difficulty getting medicines from one. That's unlikely in Manchester.

Signature
[B23] [ ] Signature of Patient  [✔] Signature on behalf of patient
      Sign here yourself, by hand.
[B24] Date: write the date you sign it, by hand.

Things to finish by hand:
- B01: choose Miss or no title.
- B03: check the date format.
- B08: add the country if the town is there alone.
- B09/B10: split the address so the postcode is only in B10.
- B17 and B21: they depend on when she came to the UK and her age.
- Sign and date B23/B24.
- Look at the back of the form too. It has the organ donation section and asks for the practice or doctor you are registering with.
